text:
Existen estadísticas. Sabemos

cuántos corazones humanos is paran for minuto.

And vivimos in paz. También to the nuestro

le llegara his hora.

But estamos metidos in the salón of  espejos

where the mundo is makes.

In cada espejo afirma and us afirma

and lo afirmamos. When alguno quiebra

or is desluce repentinamente,

there is a largo vacío of tiniebla

as when the light is apaga in a discurso

and lo disuelve.

Ha llegado the hora and not ha llegado.

The espejo abolido abre other galería

that gives toward lo irreal and the mundo queda

as suspenso. Pronto reanuda

his imperio. Están the otros and until alguno

new for volvernos to the oficio

that not consuela lo that pierde.

Because quedamos empañados, vueltos,

in a vapor of niebla,

toward the galería tan profunda as the pain,

tan rica of fantasmas as the life misma

already casi for entero desovillada in nuestros pasos.

Caminando for ella,

recreando his escenarios with relieve sordo,

is va embotando lo that was punzante

as the sobrecarga of the latido

that is abulta in the soledad of the sufrimiento

and is makes already desgana of return to the presente.

Is endulza to more pain,

to pain apiadado,

volviendo the head with the eyes llovidos,

llevándonos to hablar with nuestros muertos.
